status: actual registered source schemas; handlers not executed for schema capture

tools.name: playtest_start
tools.description: Start an explicitly authorized playtest for one named application with a scenario description.

pid.description: Process ID of that window, from computer_use list_windows; needed so the window can be captured before each action

tools.name: playtest_action
tools.description: Perform ONE native computer-use action on the selected app. Optionally record a restricted non-text action for explicit step-by-step replay. Host approvals remain in force; observations are separate.

action.description: The native computer_use action as an object, for example {"action": "key", "keys": "Right"} or {"action": "key", "keys": "space", "delivery_mode": "foreground", "bring_to_front": true}. Do not wrap it again and do not repeat run_id or app inside it. For movement or jumps in an action game use {"action": "hold", "keys": ["Right"], "seconds": 1.5} (up to three keys together, at most 3 seconds): a tap is too short for a game that reads held keys, For a one-shot pause key use a short tap or 0.05–0.1 second hold, then wait and inspect; holding it longer can toggle pause repeatedly. A hold requests a capture one quarter of the way through; slow capture can arrive after key release, so inspect the image rather than assuming its timing. A wait action with seconds from 0 to 30 captures the window after the delay. Input actions request a fresh capture; its pixel size is in the result and click coordinates use that frame.

tools.name: playtest_replay
tools.description: Replay one explicitly selected, previously observed non-text action into a separate run of the same named app. Verify coordinates and state first; host approvals remain in force.

tools.name: playtest_observe
tools.description: Record a user/agent observation after inspecting actual game state. The result is a human observation, not automatic proof.

tools.name: playtest_report
tools.description: Read playtest intentions, action acknowledgment and separately recorded observations.

tools.name: playtest_check
tools.description: Capture before, during and after one approved input and measure the change. Record the verdict with playtest_observe.

action.description: Example: {"action": "hold", "keys": ["Right"], "seconds": 1.5}; key uses the same shape; click uses coordinate.

pause_probe.description: Capture again after one second to test whether the frame is frozen.

resume_key.description: Optional key to unpause after the pause probe; compare the resumed frame.

dismiss_key.description: Optional key to dismiss a visible panel before performing this input, within this approval.

tools.name: playtest_read_value
tools.description: Capture and magnify a fractional window region to read a HUD value.

region.description: [left, top, right, bottom] as fractions of the window

step.description: Optional recorded check to crop instead of the current window

frame.description: Recorded frame label, such as after or one second later; default after

tools.name: playtest_run
tools.description: Run a complete checklist on the selected game window with one approval. Relay its report without changing verdicts.

items.description: move/move_vertical: keys and hold; freeze: key and resume_key; value: label and expect.

clips.description: Optional. A failed check gets a short MP4 by default (needs ffmpeg). Set enabled false to skip, or change the seconds kept around the failure.

tools.name: playtest_clips
tools.description: Make or re-cut short captioned MP4 clips of failed checks from a finished playtest_run, saved beside its evidence. Built from the run's own frames (a slideshow, not full-motion video), or from a screen recording you made yourself if you give its path and wall-clock start time. Passing checks only get a clip if named.

checks.description: Check names to clip, any verdict. Omit to clip every FAIL.

before_seconds.description: Seconds before the failure moment; default 3.

reel.description: Also join all clips in order into one reel; default true.

recording.description: A recording the user made with their own recorder.

path.description: Absolute path of the recording file

start_time.description: When the recording started: ISO 8601 time with zone, or seconds since 1970
